allowed_discretization_differences.operators: Inherited M-PREP1: grad x2, hessian x4, quadrature weights x1/4, points same; kr unchanged. Q1 piecewise approximation and integration samples change; no claim of invariant local force/owner IDs.
allowed_discretization_differences.port: 3→5 reference segment nodes;normalized trapezoid weights as above, same physical average control; individual port nodes remain untied
allowed_discretization_differences.identity: derived geometry/task hashes, node/cell/DOF indices, field shapes/archive hashes differ as expected
allowed_discretization_differences.observations: 14 identically defined stored quantities at same original target index/leg. Existing values differ; stored fine-minus-coarse retained, no new difference/percentage computation.

observation_definitions.q_out_mm: normalized reference-arclength weighted output displacement; not tip displacement
observation_definitions.tip: one reference node(80,30), h1 ID2630/h05 ID10300; unsigned shortest distance to finite square bottom/left/right segments; not contact proof/pressure or node-window clearance/ray-gap
observation_definitions.weak_body_forces: signed full lower-body nodal weak-force sums; material and Hu components, body-priority nonoverlap holding partition; nodal physical/cut/intersection groups are node sets, not owner-cell partitions/traction
observation_definitions.solid_min_J: minimum saved integration-point J over original solid cells
observation_definitions.medium_min_J: minimum saved integration-point J over original medium EXCLUDING fixed-body cells
observation_definitions.medium_max_abs_Hu_per_mm: maximum absolute saved Hu component over free medium excluding fixed-body cells; not Frobenius norm shown in field plot
observation_definitions.field_plots: cell-mean J and cell Hu Frobenius norm; solid in-plane Green principal strain; these are different statistic definitions from min-J/max-component CSV

qualification_and_unknowns.mesh_convergence: Two mesh responses establish sensitivity only. No asymptotic convergence/rate/bound, branch uniqueness, contact-onset/clamping/pressure qualification.
